      ) WITHOUT ROWID

results.name: users
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  nickname TEXT DEFAULT '',
  avatar TEXT DEFAULT '',
  visit_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_visit_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

results.name: works
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE works (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  work_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT DEFAULT '',
  category TEXT DEFAULT '',
  synopsis TEXT DEFAULT '',
  payload TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
  version INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  chapter_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  total_words INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

results.name: idx_works_user_work
results.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_works_user_work ON works(user_id, work_id)

results.name: work_snapshots
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE work_snapshots (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  work_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  payload_hash TEXT DEFAULT '',
  payload TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
  version INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  size INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

results.name: cloud_api_keys
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE cloud_api_keys (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  key_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  last4 TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

results.name: sync_logs
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE sync_logs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  work_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT DEFAULT 'sync',
  device TEXT DEFAULT '',
  ip TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)
